purpose: Registered customers browse their own persisted sample workspace, menus and initial forms. Every internal Save and Continue action is disabled. Only signup and first workspace provisioning write data.

api.client: Use the existing Supabase browser client with the branch-scoped public URL and publishable key.
api.authority: Real Auth session plus database workspace ownership. Never trust a role or workspace ID from user_metadata, a role selector, query parameters or localStorage.
api.public_demo_auth: Verified email/password session. AAL1 is allowed for viewing this sample-only preview; native MFA requirements remain unchanged.
api.consent: Privacy acceptance required; marketing consent optional and separate; phone is contact-only, not SMS verified.
signup_sequence: Collect registration fields, required privacy acknowledgement and optional separate marketing consent.
Use real Supabase Auth signUp; contact metadata may prefill registration, never grant authority.
If no session is returned, show confirmation pending; resume after the verified callback. Never disable email verification to make a test pass.
Call demo_get_my_workspace_v1. If null, validate registration with demo_initialize_workspace_v1; otherwise load the existing workspace.
A repeated initialization is read-only for an existing workspace: it does not reseed or overwrite its name, locale, profile or consent.
Show menus, lists, SQL-derived reports and initial forms. Save, Submit, Continue, Send, Dispatch and other operational controls remain disabled.
Any form input used for preview remains transient in memory only; do not save it through RPC or browser persistence. Clear it on account change/logout.
api.workspace_descriptor: demo_mode=preview_only; role=demo_owner means UID ownership only. All navigation entries are read_only or locked. features.form_preview=true, demo_data_write=false, workflow_continue=false; all sensitive flags=false.

demo_get_my_workspace_v1.returns: null or workspace descriptor with id, name, locale, is_demo, role, navigation, features and own profile

arguments.p_mobile: 8..15 digits, optional leading plus; spaces/parentheses/hyphens normalized

demo_initialize_workspace_v1.semantics: One workspace per real verified Auth user; first registration atomically creates its private lead and sample workspace. Repeating the call returns the unchanged existing descriptor and cannot act as a profile/consent/workspace edit API.

demo_list_items_v1.returns: workspace_id, is_demo, items, total, limit, offset

demo_get_reports_v1.returns: workspace_id, is_demo, generated_at, counts, maintenance, finance, activity, source, native_business_data
demo_get_reports_v1.financial_truth: Use these SQL-derived sample totals and periods. Do not invent bank balances or real ledger results from them.

sensitive_actions_closed: all internal item saves and edits
all internal Continue or Submit actions
contact messages to owners tenants or contractors

seed.visibility: Clearly label all data as sample. Existing sample statuses describe seeded examples, not operations performed by the viewer. Forms can be previewed but cannot save or continue.

frontend_acceptance: Real signup, verification callback, login and automatic own-workspace provisioning on the actual staging preview.
No manual administrator, shared pilot workspace, native membership or role simulation is needed for signup.

Site-relevant menus, sample records and initial forms are visible according to server preview_only navigation/features. Save/Continue and every internal mutation remain disabled with a clear localized explanation.

Initial forms for building/workspace details, owners/tenants, contractor contacts and maintenance planning are previews only. No item creation, profile edit, message, assignment, booking, payment or operational transition is submitted.
Replace static MOCK demo reports with demo_list_items_v1 and demo_get_reports_v1 reads; paginate75 sample records instead of silently showing only the default50.
Workspace registration fields are collected once. Repeated initialization or reload does not overwrite contact/consent/workspace data.
Two separate authenticated sessions see only their own samples; logout/account switch clears prior state and late responses cannot leak data.
Direct calls to disabled item write RPCs fail as well as buttons being disabled. No native Operations/financial endpoint, service secret, privileged role grant or safeguard removal.

RO/EN/FA desktop/mobile evidence shows menus, lists, forms, disabled Save/Continue and unchanged sample reports after attempted actions. Include keyboard/focus/error/loading states and comparable performance evidence.
Typecheck, relevant lint/build and callback/demo browser checks on the submitted SHA. Backend Auth fixtures admin-confirmed by the test are not mail-delivery or browser proof.

verification.cleanup_command: Same environment and command with argument cleanup; never commit the private session file

installation_warning: Apply in this order. Earlier source files are historical installation steps, not the current write policy; never replay them over the final preview-only restrictions.

demo_create_item_v1.reason: Execute revoked from PUBLIC, anon, authenticated and service_role; function body unconditionally denies all saves/edits/workflow transitions.

demo_update_item_v1.reason: Execute revoked from PUBLIC, anon, authenticated and service_role; function body unconditionally denies all saves/edits/workflow transitions.
